was: Osceola County park on Rose Lake near LeRoy (RV Life lists the city as Cadillac). ~160 modern sites with water & electric plus a dozen primitive; dump station, swimming beach, boat launch, store. note: Osceola County park on Rose Lake near LeRoy, with a swimming beach and boat launch.  Every camper must back in, and generators aren't allowed. --Claude

was: Private resort on the Carp River at the base of Marquette Mountain, ~5 min from downtown Marquette (4321 M-553). ~50 full-hookup RV sites (30/50 amp, water, sewer) plus tent sites and 14 cabins; max RV ~45 ft. Reservable online via Campspot. Open year-round (water/sewer shut late fall to late spring). Pool, hot tub, dump station, camp store/bar. RV Life mislabels this as county; it is a private resort. RV Life: 4.0* / $$$ --Claude
note: Private resort on the Carp River at the foot of Marquette Mountain, about 5 minutes from downtown Marquette, with about 50 full-hookup RV sites, tent sites, 14 cabins, a pool, a hot tub and a bar.  Open all year, but the water and sewer hookups are shut off from late fall to late spring. --Claude

was: City of Marquette campground on the Dead River Basin (Tourist Park Lake impoundment), ~40 acres. 110 sites: ~100 with electric (38 with water+sewer), rest rustic tent; max RV ~44 ft. Restrooms, hot showers, dump station, playground. Reservable online via Campspot. 2026 season ~May 22-Oct 18. --Claude
note: City of Marquette campground on 40 wooded acres fronting the Dead River at the north edge of town, a mile from the Lake Superior beaches, with a sandy beach, two playgrounds, hiking trails, a bike pump track, and links to the city bike path and the Noquemanon trails.  About 100 sites have electric, 38 of them with water and sewer too; the rest are primitive tent sites. --Claude

note: Private RV park on Hopeville Pond in Griswold, formerly Campers World on Hopeville Pond, open about six months a year.  Seasonal lots, with some sites sold by the night; a pump-out service comes to the sites. --Claude

was: Drive-in RV + tent campground at 56 Campground Rd, Rumney, on the Baker River; ~62 sites (21 full-hookup, 21 electric/water), 50/30/20-amp, pull-thrus, max RV 40 ft. Open ~late May (Memorial Day)-mid Oct (Columbus Day). Both nightly-transient (reservable online via Campspot) and returning seasonal campers. River beach for swimming/fishing/tubing. Operator: Modern America Campgrounds (sister property Riverbrook RV Resort is a separate campground ~10 min away). --Claude
note: The Baker River half of Modern America's Riverbrook & Baker River in Rumney, on the river, with a beach for swimming, fishing and tubing.  Riverbrook, its sister campground a mile west on Route 25, has the office, and Campspot books both on one listing.  Open from Memorial Day to Columbus Day, for seasonal campers as well as nightly ones. --Claude

was: Private family campground at 1753 Mohawk Trail (Route 2), East Charlemont, in the Berkshires near the Deerfield River. Open May 1-Oct 31. Pull-through and shaded sites with full hookups (W/E/S) or water/electric; tent sites and rental cabins also. Gravel roads, grass sites; operator states no RV size limit (reviews cite rigs up to ~50 ft). Both transient (daily/weekly/monthly) and seasonal sites; nightly reservable online via Campspot. Camp store, pool, playground, dump station. --Claude
note: Private family campground on the Mohawk Trail (Route 2) in East Charlemont, in the Berkshires near the Deerfield River, with rental cabins, a snack bar, a game room and a picnic pavilion; seasonal sites as well as nightly ones.
